text.【上質マンションリフォーム講座】漆喰でつくる心地よく美しい住まいを開催いたします: A seminar on fine apartment renovation: a comfortable, beautiful home built in lime plaster
text.TIMELESS LIVINGは日本の気候や風土に適した漆喰などの素材にこだわり: Timeless Living works with materials suited to Japan's climate — lime plaster among them — to make, through renovation, city apartments that grow more comfortable and more beautiful as the years pass.
text.本講座では漆喰を用いたマンションリフォームの魅力について、TIMELESS LI: In this seminar we explain what makes an apartment renovation in lime plaster worth doing, drawing on projects we have completed, and we do so carefully, with one party at a time.
text.マンションのリフォームをご検討中の方や、これから検討される方もお気軽にご参加くだ: Whether you are already considering renovating an apartment or are only beginning to think about it, you are very welcome to join us.
text.リフォームを前提に物件を探されていた、小さなお子さんとの3人暮らしのご家族。選ば: A family of three, with a small child, looking for an apartment with renovation already in mind. What they chose was a flat in a tower block on the bay. The positions and the design of the doors were reworked so that the living room reads as open, and the bedroom, wrapped in lime plaster, became a gentle room in which one can rest. A home that never feels small for all its compactness: wrapped in natural materials and lime plaster, light, open and easy to be in.
text.北欧ヴィンテージやPoul Kjaerholm（ポール・ケアホルム）の家具など、: A fine apartment renovation where real things are shown at their best — Scandinavian vintage, furniture by Poul Kjærholm. Walls and ceilings finished in lime plaster, and a terrace deck in the same solid teak as the living room, join the home to its private garden and make an open, settled space. Niches are set into the limestone wall facing the entrance and into the living-room fireplace, so that something can be put out for each season. A home appointed with the ease of a detached house.
